title: Last.fm Scrobble Play Count Leaderboard
dataSources: Tautulli/Plex playback (`tautulli:play`), Jellyfin activity (`jellyfin:activity`), Spotify recently-played (`spotify:play`), Steam player/achievements (`steam:player`), Sonarr/Radarr events (`sonarr:event`).
app: Plex / Jellyfin (Tautulli), Sonos, Spotify, Steam, Xbox/PSN, and *arr stack (Sonarr/Radarr) APIs and webhooks via HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lastfm:scrobble play_count=*
| stats sum(play_count) as total_value, avg(play_count) as avg_value by artist
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks artist values by total and average play count across Last.fm scrobble events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `play_count` values for each Last.fm scrobble event and review total and average play count by artist.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total play count.
grandmaExplanation: It clearly which artist shows the biggest play count numbers in your Last.fm scrobble data.
